title: Breaking: The EU has fully rejected a US threat to ban diesel exports to Europe unless the
summary: The EU has fully rejected a US threat to ban diesel exports to Europe unless the bloc releases more fuel from its strategic reserves, escalating a transatlantic dispute over energy supply management.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Oct 01, 2026
summary: Added a Sept 28 event: Putin signed a decree classifying refinery output, export contracts and tanker-route data, cutting independent visibility into the fuel balance. The diesel export ban (to Oct 31) and gasoline export ban (to January) remain in force, and regional purchase limits stay in place. No other sections changed.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sep 30, 2026
summary: Russia extended its diesel export ban for fuel producers through Oct 31, citing harvest-season demand; the gasoline export ban remains in place through January 2027. Regions including Kaluga (odd-even plates), Zabaikalsky (15 L cap) and Leningrad (30 L cap) have reimposed purchase limits. The national average gasoline price is 78.51 RUB/L (+21% year to date) and the anti-monopoly service is probing 58 price-gouging cases.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Mon Sep 28, 2026
summary: Putin decree classifies refinery output, export contracts and tanker-route data.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Sep 27, 2026
summary: Enriched the Sept 26 Ilsky refinery strike with confirmed casualties (3 killed, 2 injured) and additional sourcing (Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Militarnyi) after the hourly pipeline's initial single-source entry. Updated crude processing KPI/econ figures to the more recent 3.6M bbl/day (24-year low, Jul 2026) reading. Added a claim tracking the credibility of the Trump-brokered 'energy ceasefire' proposal, which neither side has yet honored, plus political entries for Trump, Zelensky and Krasnodar Governor Kondratiev. No new events found for the Sept 24 gap day beyond what is already captured in the Sept 25 overnight-strikes entry.

summary: Ukraine struck the Ilsky oil refinery in southern Russia (Krasnodar region), a target distinct from the Perm and Novoshakhtinsk refineries hit in earlier strikes.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Sep 25, 2026
summary: Ukraine hits Perm and Novoshakhtinsk refineries again overnight; one killed near Perm.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Wed Sep 23, 2026
summary: More Russian regions reimposed fuel purchase limits this week as the renewed drone campaign against refineries (Yaroslavl Sept 17, Moscow Sept 20, Samara/Ufa Sept 22) fed through to retail supply.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Sep 22, 2026
summary: Drones hit Kuibyshev refinery in Samara and Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa; one killed.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Mon Sep 21, 2026
summary: Moscow Oil Refinery confirmed fully halted after Sept 20 drone strike; repairs expected to take weeks.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Sep 20, 2026
summary: Drones hit Moscow's own Kapotnya refinery — supplier of 40% of the capital's fuel — in year's largest overnight barrage.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Sep 18, 2026
summary: A drone strike overnight Sept 16-17 sparked a major fire at the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl, one of Russia's five largest, closing a section of the M-8 highway to Moscow — its ninth strike of the year. The update also folds in the second Saratov strike (Sept 11), the Slavyansk-on-Kuban/Taneco strikes (Sept 13), and the Syzran refinery's total loss of distillation capacity plus Reuters' finding that three of Russia's six largest diesel refineries are now halted or curtailed (Sept 15). New KPIs track that half of the top-6 diesel refineries are down and that AI-92/AI-95 gasoline is now unavailable at 45%/53% of stations nationwide, up sharply from late August.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Thu Sep 17, 2026
summary: A Ukrainian drone attack overnight on Sept 16-17 hit the primary oil distillation unit at the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl, sparking a large fire, regional governor Mikhail Yevraev confirmed.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Sep 15, 2026
summary: Ukrainian special forces strike Syzran oil refinery and Atlant Aero drone plant; refinery halts operations. Reuters: 3 of Russia's 6 largest diesel refineries now curbed or halted by drone strikes. Leningrad Oblast caps fuel purchases at 30 liters as Kirishi refinery remains offline.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Sep 13, 2026
summary: Drones hit Slavyansk-on-Kuban and Nizhnekamsk (Taneco) refineries overnight.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Sep 11, 2026
summary: Ukraine's General Staff confirmed a second drone strike on the Saratov oil refinery overnight on Sept 11, just three days after the Sept 8 strike on the same plant.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Wed Sep 9, 2026
summary: Drone strike sets fire to Novorossiysk fuel oil terminal, Russia's key Black Sea export hub.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Sep 8, 2026
summary: Drones strike Saratov oil refinery and Ozon warehouse overnight.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Mon Sep 7, 2026
summary: Novak convenes fuel-market staff meeting, orders refinery maintenance deferrals and independent-station price pacts.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Sep 6, 2026
summary: Ryazan refinery struck again — Isomal-2 isomerization unit knocked out.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Thu Sep 3, 2026
summary: Novak says fuel market 'partially stabilized' at Eastern Economic Forum, acknowledges lingering gasoline shortfall.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Wed Sep 2, 2026
summary: Kirishi (KINEF) refinery confirmed at zero output — Russia's second-largest refinery fully offline.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Sep 1, 2026
summary: Russia turns to Kazakhstan's Kondensat refinery to process crude as domestic capacity collapses.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Mon Aug 31, 2026
summary: Russia expands downgraded-fuel decree to Euro-2 and Euro-4, extends it through mid-2027.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Aug 30, 2026
summary: Fire reported at Kirishi (KINEF) refinery, Russia's second-largest, as it prepared to resume output.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sat Aug 29, 2026
summary: Reuters reported Russia's gasoline output has fallen to about 70% of domestic demand, a roughly 35,000-tonne/day shortfall, after fresh drone strikes disabled the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl (1 killed, 27 injured) and Rosneft's Kuibyshev refinery in Samara (both crude units down) on Aug 28. Russia is leaning harder on Asian and Belarusian gasoline imports to close the gap. KPI, economic, claims and political sections updated with the new output figures and Governor Yevrayev's statement.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Aug 28, 2026
summary: Drone strike sparks fire at Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl, killing one. Rosneft's Kuibyshev refinery in Samara halted again after drone strike on both crude units.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Thu Aug 27, 2026
summary: Meduza analyzed 478,685 crowdsourced fuel-availability reports from the GdeBENZ app, covering 25,129 gas stations between July 4 and August 23, to size up the second wave of the crisis.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Wed Aug 26, 2026
summary: Official Rosstat data for August 18-24 showed gasoline prices rising in most Russian regions, with the national average up 0.9% week-on-week to 77.05 RUB/liter (from 76.38 on Aug 17).

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Tue Aug 25, 2026
summary: Ukrainian drones struck southern Russia overnight, sparking a fire at the Afipsky oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai and damaging the Novoshakhtinsky refinery in Rostov region.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Mon Aug 24, 2026
summary: Ukrainian drones strike Astrakhan gas processing plant, 800km from the front.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sun Aug 23, 2026
summary: Gasoline sales restrictions now cover 58 of 89 Russian regions as export ban continues. Putin acknowledges 'certain inconveniences' as restrictions reach 63 of 85 regions.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sat Aug 22, 2026
summary: Drones hit Novokuibyshevsk refinery and Ozon warehouse in one of the deepest strikes of the summer.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Aug 21, 2026
summary: Ukrainian drones set Lukoil's Perm refinery ablaze, 1,500km from the front.

title: Breaking: Russia's domestic fuel crisis enters a second wave as Moscow is forced to purcha
summary: Russia's domestic fuel crisis enters a second wave as Moscow is forced to purchase expensive gasoline imports from Asian markets to offset refinery shortfalls.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Wed Aug 19, 2026
summary: A Ukrainian drone struck the AVT-6 unit at the Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa, Bashkortostan, sparking a fire at a unit that regional head Radiy Khabirov said was already undergoing maintenance.

title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Sat Aug 15, 2026
summary: Kaluga region introduces odd-even gasoline rationing.
